Cabbie's smoky chilli beef jerky.d: Top round cut thin across the grain, soaked overnight in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar, smoked paprika, red pepper flakes and garlic, then dried low in the oven until leathery but still bendy.
Cabbie's smoky chilli beef jerky.note: Packs flat in a vest pocket.

Survival tin sardines.d: Oil-packed sardines laid on crisp crackers with a squeeze of lemon, a drop of hot sauce and chopped parsley.
Survival tin sardines.note: Served on the lid, your tin.

Scavenger's hobo stew.d: Smoked sausage browned in the pot with onion, carrot and potato, then white beans, crushed tomatoes, smoked paprika and chicken stock. Cabbage goes in at the end. Ladled into a mug.

Ration-pack chocolate oat slice.d: Rolled oats, butter, golden syrup and brown sugar pressed into a pan and baked golden, spread with dark chocolate and finished with flaky salt. Cut in squares.

Brain's bathtub moonshine sour.d: Corn whiskey shaken hard with fresh lemon and sugar, poured over ice in a jelly jar.
